name: Texture Array Sampling with Alpha Discard
aliases: Texture Array Sampling with Alpha Discard — Fragment Shader Texture Sampling, SPIRV_Cross_CombinedtextureArraytextureSampler Sampling
definition: GLSL fragment shader that samples a texture array, discards transparent pixels, and outputs color with alpha.
summary: Texture Array Sampling with Alpha Discard is a fragment shader technique that samples 3D texture arrays and discards low-alpha fragments to optimize rendering by avoiding overdraw, differing from proxy geometry approaches by relying on hardware sampling and early-Z rejection.
